missions.name: Beacons in the Dark
missions.description: Find hope in a desperate labyrinth

i18nLines: The labyrinth of darkness has consumed many souls.
But with faith and hope, even the darkest paths can be illuminated.
With the lamps of hope lit, the darkness recedes.
Despair is defeated, and the path ahead is illuminated.

missions.name: Reboot the Station
missions.description: Reactivate a derelict space station by collecting power cells and solving the wiring puzzle

i18nLines: Warning: station power failure imminent. Collect power cells to restart the reactor.
The station's reactor is online. Nexus has been defeated.

puzzles.i18nPrompt: Correctly connect the wires to reactivate the station's systems.

missions.name: The Armor of God
missions.description: Learn the full armor of God piece by piece, then confront the Adversary.

lines: Stand therefore, having fastened on the belt of truth.
The belt holds everything together. Without truth, the rest falls apart.
Having put on the readiness of the gospel of peace.
Your feet must be shod — ready to move, ready to share the good news.
Take up the helmet of salvation.
Protect your mind. The enemy attacks your thoughts first.

i18nLines: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the devil.
Learn each piece, gather them from the demons that hold them, and you will be ready.
Stand therefore, having fastened on the belt of truth.
The belt holds everything together. Without truth, the rest falls apart.
Having put on the readiness of the gospel of peace.
Your feet must be shod — ready to move, ready to share the good news.
Take up the helmet of salvation.
Protect your mind. The enemy attacks your thoughts first.
You stood firm. The armor held.
Therefore take up the whole armor of God, that you may withstand in the evil day.
Having done all, to stand firm.

missions.name: Trials of Grace
missions.description: A journey through faith, courage, and hope to overcome the shadows of Despair.

lines: Faith is the assurance of things hoped for. Hold this lamp—it will show the way where sight fails.
Memorize Hebrews 11:1, and the first path will open.

puzzle.prompt: Fill in the missing words from Hebrews 11:1.
puzzle.answer: Now faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not seen.

lines: You carry the verse well. The lantern burns brighter when faith holds it.
Fear stalks these halls, but courage is not the absence of fear—it is trust in the Lord's command.
Take Joshua 1:9 to heart, and the shield is yours to claim.

puzzle.prompt: Fill in the missing words from Joshua 1:9.
puzzle.answer: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.

lines: When the road grows long, hope sustains the weary heart.
Romans 15:13 is a promise: God fills us with all joy and peace as we trust in Him.

puzzle.prompt: Fill in the missing words from Romans 15:13.
puzzle.answer: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that by the power of the Holy Spirit you may abound in hope.

lines: I saw the shadow take the page. It feeds on lost hope—but your light pushed it back.
Keep walking. The key lies deeper in, beyond the place where many turn back.
I came this way before. The bridge collapsed behind me—Despair shattered it.
But I remember an old prayer. If you learn it, the path may yet be restored.
Philippians 4:6-7. Do not be anxious. The peace of God will guard your heart.
The bridge fell, but prayer builds what strength cannot.
Take Philippians 4:6-7, and the key will turn where the way was broken.

puzzle.prompt: Fill in the missing words from Philippians 4:6-7.
puzzle.answer: Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

lines: You carry faith, courage, and hope together. Few make it this far.
The key responds to prayer. Take it—the crown waits beyond the gate.
You have come far, but the final trial is the hardest.
James 1:12: the one who endures temptation will receive the crown of life.
Hold this verse close. It is your last grace before the shadow.

puzzle.prompt: Fill in the missing words from James 1:12.
puzzle.answer: Blessed is the man who remains steadfast under trial, for when he has stood the test he will receive the crown of life, which God has promised to those who love him.

i18nLines: The path ahead is shadowed, child. Each trial will test a different grace.
Learn the verses, carry the symbols, and let faith be your lamp.

Despair dissolves. The labyrinth brightens, and the symbols of grace glow in your hands.
Elder Marcus: 'You have walked through every trial and stood. Remember—grace carries what strength cannot.'
